levels: at_risk — open gap likely to fail review

merge_evidence.instructions: Rate the merge evidence: the phase PR is merged, cited by PR number or merge SHA in the STATUS row.

gate_tests.instructions: Rate whether named hermetic gate tests exist for this phase and are cited.

verification.instructions: Rate the verification evidence: local gates, CI, and the self-audit bar.

status_honesty.instructions: Rate whether the STATUS row is honest: no complete claim while open, repair, or failing language remains.

residual_scope.instructions: Rate whether residual or deferred work is tracked as its own row rather than hidden inside a complete claim.

dogfood.instructions: Rate live dogfood evidence for user-facing lanes: receipts, cost, fallback rate.

merge_pending.label: Merge evidence missing
merge_pending.suggested_next_action: Drive the PR to green CI, merge it, and cite PR #/merge SHA in the STATUS row.

tests_missing.label: Named gate tests missing
tests_missing.suggested_next_action: Add the named hermetic gate tests to the phase contract and make them pass.

gates_unverified.label: Gates or CI unverified
gates_unverified.suggested_next_action: Run the local battery and audits/self/audit.py to BAR MET; cite the CI run.

status_dishonest.label: STATUS claim contradicts evidence
status_dishonest.suggested_next_action: Correct the STATUS wording so the claim matches the evidence (no complete while open).

residual_untracked.label: Residual work hidden in a complete claim
residual_untracked.suggested_next_action: Split residual/deferred work into its own open STATUS row with an owner, or close it with evidence.

dogfood_missing.label: Live dogfood evidence missing
dogfood_missing.suggested_next_action: Run paid-cheap live dogfood on the user-facing lane; record receipt, cost, and fallback rate.
